newsitem.title: USA: Berger Holdings says expects Q1 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Berger Holdings says expects Q1 net profit.

text.p: Berger Holdings Ltd said its revenue increased 24.6 percent to $4.5 million for the quarter ending March 31 from $3,611,000 for the comparable 1996 quarter.
Joseph Weiderman, president and chief operating officer, said "we expect to report a profit for the first quarter versus a loss of $37,764 in the comparable 1996 quarter."
Berger Holdings Ltd is the parent company of Berger Building Products and is a manufacturer of roof drainage products and solid vinyl siding.
